cases.about: Her obituary said she was a data entry coordinator Senior Health Care Associates of Hermitage and also worked part time for Thunder Harley-Davidson. Cheryl’s passion was working out with her friends at both Body by Boyd and at Planet Fitness and a good workout for Cheryl was only achieved in “Beast Mode”. She was always hosting get togethers for family and friends and she loved to cook and bake.
